root.rationale: The one-unit unstructured-search exposure supplies only a local work scale, not an observed pre/post credit measure. At the common horizon the two accepted contributions substantially overlap: the affine-area proof fully resolves the objective, while the vector contribution independently supplies almost all of its geometric core. Removing the affine-area proof leaves only a short area-scaling inference; removing the vector detail leaves the complete accepted proof. The remaining shared or overdetermined value is retained as unattributed rather than duplicated across children.
